location: Kelly Forks Campground / river-left landing, North Fork Clearwater River and Kelly Creek, Idaho
coordinateInterpretation: Remote Forest Service campground/work-center and river-left landing access-area anchor; not surveyed wet-toe coordinate.
accessCondition: Remote and seasonal. Confirm Forest Service road opening, campground status, parking, carry, and exact river landing before travel.

evidence.claim: American Whitewater identifies Kelly Forks Access at the Kelly Creek / North Fork Clearwater confluence, with a campground on river left and Forest Service work center on river right.
The North Fork Clearwater access guide identifies Kelly Forks Campground as the standard access for the headwaters reach.
Forest Service information corroborates the Kelly Forks work center and remote seasonal access conditions.
The selected take-out was 306 feet from the named Kelly Creek flowline and 246 feet from mapped water before the route-scoped control was extended.
